title: A Harbor for the Typewriter
author: Lior Sterling
blurb: Quentin Ishikawa, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
